question: What final attainment does the chief yogin reach at the end of the body?
premises: The subject is the chief yogin.
The time specified is the end of the body.
The attained state is supreme bliss and brahman-liberation.
inference: At bodily death, the chief yogin attains the supreme bliss state of brahman-liberation.
plain_english: At the end of the body, the chief yogin attains the supreme state of bliss, which is liberation in Brahman.
